subject.title: Feature: per-channel announce suppression for sub-agents

question: Which public completion-delivery primitive should OpenClaw expose for sub-agent announcements: per-channel suppression, global/per-spawn suppression, parent/internal routing, hook-based filtering, or one unified announce policy?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but the fix adds public config/tool surface and overlaps several open routing and suppression requests that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Unify Completion Policy
options.body: Add one additive policy that defaults to current behavior and can express channel suppression, deterministic skip, and internal-only completion delivery without parallel controls.

options.title: Narrow Per-Channel Suppression
options.body: Add only a channel-level suppression key and leave global suppression, parent routing, and hooks tracked separately.

options.title: Defer To Broader Routing Work
options.body: Keep this blocked until maintainers choose a broader announceTarget or post-completion hook API that can subsume channel suppression.

recommendation.title: Unify Completion Policy
recommendation.body: Add one additive policy that defaults to current behavior and can express channel suppression, deterministic skip, and internal-only completion delivery without parallel controls.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history and existing maintainer-facing review context point to steipete as the strongest owner for the announce-delivery policy decision.
